svg.title: D7 The gradient as a sum of rank-one pieces
svg.desc: For W used once per site, G = Δ^T U = Σ_i g_i b_i^T exactly, constant mode and complement included [thm, A3]. Inside a near-degenerate block the pieces depend on the basis; the block sum G_B = Δ^T Π_B U, its norm and interactions do not.

text.tspan: The gradient as a sum of rank-one pieces
gradient of D4 (6 × 3): each piece is a column g
in a basis rotated by 40°: new pieces, same sum
this is the gradient, not the optimizer's update
g column and b row each on its own scale; products share G's scale
For W used once per site, G = Δ
exactly, constant mode and complement included [thm, A3].
Inside a near-degenerate block the pieces depend on the basis; the block sum G
U, its norm and interactions do not.
